spark: Jervaise left her younger brother bound to a debt-master to buy her own way out of the valley, and never went back for him

focal.name: Jervaise Greyfell
focal.who: A quiet swordswoman from the hill valleys who sends coin somewhere every season.
focal.backstory: Jervaise Greyfell bought her way out of a debt-bound valley by leaving her younger brother bound to the debt-master in her place. She swore she would come back for him, and she never has.
